name: rerun_of_doubtful_measurements
description: Find the measurement points whose repetitions disagree too much to be trusted, run them again with additional repetitions, and report whether the medians already published survive the extra evidence.

human_decisions.note: H13 adds repetitions to points that were already measured under the frozen configuration; it changes no frozen parameter, so it needs no new experiment version. The freeze leaves the number of extra repetitions open and requires the reason for every rerun to be recorded.

doubt_rule.definition: (max - min) / median of the per-repetition write-phase seconds of one measurement point
doubt_rule.why_the_write_phase: the write statement is the treatment cost the article reports; maintenance is reported separately and its spread is carried along for the record

rerun.unit: whatever the measuring script executes as one cycle: a sweep scenario for H11, the four arrivals for H12
rerun.execution: serial, one operator, the same frozen scripts with only the repetition and scenario limits set

verdict.definition: (pooled median - reported median) / reported median of the write-phase seconds
verdict.consequence_if_shifted: the reported number is corrected in the article and the correction is recorded in the decision log; H13 never silently replaces a published median
verdict.reported_medians_stay: the H11 and H12 tables keep the medians of their own repetitions; the pooled median is reported next to them, never in place of them

verification.state_checks: every rerun repeats the state checks of its own stage, and a rerun with a single mismatch is discarded instead of pooled
verification.environment: the rerun must report the same frozen node, the same stack checksums and a clean working tree

measurement_boundary.claim_limit: comparative between treatments on the declared 2 vCPU VM; never a performance or scalability claim
measurement_boundary.statistics: medians with minimum and maximum only; the repetition counts do not support significance testing

invariants: the doubt rule is applied mechanically to every measured point, not to a chosen subset
every rerun passes the state verification of its own stage
reported medians and pooled medians are both published
every rerun is recorded in the decision log with the reason that triggered it
